paragraphs: R' Yaakov, son of R' Yannai.
Mentioned in Soferim, chapter 16, halakhah 3, where R' Nechemyah reports in his name. It appears to Hyman that this R' Nechemyah is the Amora well known for aggadah in the midrashim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פט״ז ה״ג gives 16h 3 without a freshly checked named edition. Both father-title component and both Nechemyah occurrences are preserved as R'; Amora classification is not full-title evidence.

ונראה makes the identification tentative and concerns reporting Nechemyah, not Yaakov renamed. בשערי אגדה is idiomatically in the realm of aggadah, with literal gates and historical possible-title reading retained as unverified alternatives; no title of a specific book is established. The source’s midrashim qualifier remains.
